notes: Customer complaints: serial max+1 per customer and date, customer must be active, complaint code must exist and is required, repeated code refused (APP_RULES3_AR).

key_expr.COMPLAINT_CUSTOMER_DETAIL.COMPLAINT_CODE: app_rules3_ar.need_num('خطء في رقم المشكلة', 'Enter the complaint code')

info.name: CUST
info.sql: select max(decode(:G_LANG, 'en', nvl(name_e, name_a), name_a)) from customer where code = to_number(:PAGE_COMPLAINT_CUSTOMER_M_CODE)
